target.title: fix(telegram): preserve bare URL query separators
target.body:
Closes #102162

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Telegram users who receive bare URLs with multiple query parameters would see and sometimes open a link containing a literal `&` separator, causing the destination to lose the intended query parameter.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Telegram renderer now lets accepted link spans override how their visible label text is escaped. Telegram bare auto-link labels keep raw `&` separators while still escaping `<` and `>`; the anchor `href` remains HTML-attribute escaped, and labelled Markdown links keep the default label escaping.

## User Impact

Telegram messages can safely include bare URLs such as `https://example.com/?a=1&b=2` without breaking the visible/tappable destination. Existing labelled links and non-link text continue to use the normal Telegram HTML escaping path.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test extensions/telegram/src/format.wrap-md.test.ts packages/markdown-core/src/render-aware-chunking.test.ts` — passed 2 Vitest shards (`packages/markdown-core/src/render-aware-chunking.test.ts`: 8 tests; `extensions/telegram/src/format.wrap-md.test.ts`: 44 tests).
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Diff secret scan for common token/private-key patterns — passed.

## Changes

- Adds an optional per-link text escaping hook to the shared marker renderer.
- Uses that hook only for Telegram auto-linked bare URL labels where the label exactly matches the href.
- Adds regression coverage proving a bare URL query label keeps `&` while the href attribute remains safely escaped.
